{{Top|leg}}
'''Loub-paper''' was a material in the form of sheets that was used as stationery. [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] kept sheets of loub-[[Paper/Legends|paper]] bound in a [[Leather/Legends|leather]] case on her person. With her [[blood stylus]], Khai recorded various bits of data on loub-paper, such as the honorable [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Sith Saber]] [[Axela Zin]].<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>
